notes: Selfridges Home (UK), scoped to Home & Furniture per project scope note (excluding Fashion/Beauty/Tech/Food/Kids/etc). Access: direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt checked, no Claude-specific disallow (only generic faceted-nav/query-param disallows for User-agent: *, including a generic '*bestseller*' substring disallow that is not Claude-specific and does not apply to the Home department anyway). Checked: (1) main nav mega-menu on the Home & Tech department page (/GB/en/cat/home-tech/home/) - no Bestsellers entry in the Home menu; (2) full-site mega menu sweep across all department dropdowns in the homepage payload - found dedicated 'Bestsellers'/'The bestsellers' PLPs only for Beauty (/GB/en/cat/beauty/bestseller/), Bags (/GB/en/cat/bags-bestsellers/), Shoes (/GB/en/cat/shoes/shoes-bestsellers/), and Jewellery & Watches (freeText campaign link) - none for Home/Furniture; (3) in-page 'single-select-filter--*' quick-filter chips on the Home category page (Furniture, Lighting, Dining, Bathroom, Bedroom, Kitchen, Household, Laundry, Pet, Party, Seasonal, Stationery, Books, Candles, Outdoors) - no Bestsellers chip; (4) the only 'bestseller' reference on Home/category pages is a value in the generic Sort-by dropdown ('Price High-Low', 'Bestsellers'->value:'bestseller') which merely re-sorts an existing category listing and is explicitly excluded by the brief as an arbitrary filter/sort, not a standalone PLP; (5) footer nav - no Bestsellers link; (6) site search for 'bestsellers' could not be run via HTTP because robots.txt disallows all '?freetext='/'?freeText=' query URLs for every user-agent (not Claude-specific, a general crawl-budget rule), and no non-freetext internal search endpoint was found - this is a supporting-evidence gap only, not a substitute for the exhaustive nav/menu/sitemap check already done, which is conclusive absence evidence per the brief. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists for Home & Furniture on selfridges.com.
